originality.rationale: The explicit scalar sharp critical weight, globally exhaustive stable phase count in the one-defect identical-frequency ring, and transcendental large-ring coefficient were not found in the inspected closest works. They require an all-states current argument, signed quadratic-form exclusion, strict logarithmic convexity and asymptotic minimization; predecessor graph-Laplacian methods are credited, with historical priority risk noted.
residual_risks: Prior general weighted-cycle theorems might yield an equivalent theorem under straightforward specialization not stated as such; a wider literature review could discover historical priority.
The 2014 abstract was not compared to full text; it supplies only a supporting generic signed-Laplacian relation.
An all-size numerical simulation is not a substitute for the analytical proof.
